notes: *more* was given to the comparative מִן under rule 24, which heads the *more than* unit on *than*; the unit is discontinuous across *acceptable to Jehovah* under rule 25. Attaching *more* to the participle נִבְחָר was the competing reading.
No preposition stands before עֲשֹׂה, so the infinitive marker *To* belongs to the infinitive's own unit (rule 52).
